tables.name: Location in Relation to Settlement
tables.description: Where the fortress is, in relation to the nearest settlement. Skip it if you already know.

results.name: Remote
results.description: The fortress is located a significant distance away from the nearest settlement.

results.name: Outskirts
results.description: The fortress is located on the very fringes of the settlements’ occupied land, perhaps within farming country, or the stretch of land between the settlement proper and the wilderness.

results.name: Edge of Settlement
results.description: The fortress is located on the outer border of the settlement proper, perhaps connected to, or surrounded by, its border wall, if it possesses one.

results.name: Central
results.description: The fortress is located in the middle of an established settlement.

results.name: Prominent
results.description: The fortress is not only located in a central location, but is highly visible, as if it is (or was) being showcased or featured. The settlement was probably built around it.
